interpretation.independent_scheduling: Both full-text disk steps failed, but all four SQL and both helper-protocol profiles executed and passed. Overall workflow failure is retained.
interpretation.capacity_observation: Both independent 128 MiB runs had 99,254,272 bytes free immediately before reopen and zero free bytes after SIGBUS. Owned allocated bytes increased from 34,963,456 to the full 134,217,728-byte mount capacity. The clean control had no filler or injected config-save failure.
interpretation.capacity_conclusion: The full fixture exceeds the provisioned 128 MiB tmpfs allocation during writable reopen in these two runs. The clean control demonstrates that prior deliberate ENOSPC filling is not necessary for this observed failure.
interpretation.native_fault_attribution: Last emitted stage is recovery_reopen in both runs. No native backtrace, fault address or instruction is recorded; exact faulting access, file and call path are unresolved. Largest-file metadata is allocation evidence, not fault attribution.
interpretation.mapping_scope: Pre-exit mapping_rss_kib covers owned shard mappings only. It is not whole-process RSS, an OOM measurement, or post-exit resident memory.
interpretation.full_text_recovery: Neither full-text run reached an after-reopen observation or final native success report. Full-text ENOSPC recovery and clean reopen at 128 MiB remain failed gates.
interpretation.narrow_recovery: The separate 32 MiB vector/keyword fixture passed config-save ENOSPC, retry, explicit flush, reopen and eight-record/four-representation/query checks. It excludes mutable phrase/token-prefix indexes.
interpretation.helper_fault_domain: Killing/aborting the native helper preserved companion SQL in the exercised cases. SIGKILL of the PostgreSQL supervisor caused PostgreSQL recovery and terminated companion SQL; the committed marker and owner fence/replacement checks passed. This is not native-helper failure containment or durable index recovery.
interpretation.formats: All four SQL profiles passed the three candidate-format groups, including finite float32 bit preservation before JSONB normalization, rejection/budgets and ACL/runtime-superuser behavior. No public SQL vector/model contract is frozen.
interpretation.count_scope: SQL totals are assertion groups, with repeated common groups across profiles. A nested 16-check engine smoke remains one SQL/protocol assertion group; counts do not represent completed capability IDs.
interpretation.historical_failures: Earlier disk and helper failures remain separate historical records; CI6 does not retroactively identify their causes.

commands.command: docker build --file Dockerfile.p0 --build-arg P0_HELPER=1 --build-arg P0_FAULTS=1 --tag pg-qdrant-p0-helper .

reproduction.runtime_provisioning: Run disk commands only in the corresponding fresh dedicated tmpfs container specified by the committed workflow; ordinary/shared filesystems are refused. All runtime containers use the declared UID, memory/CPU/network limits.
